decisions.reason: The new design references change visual direction but do not alter the current brand name, logo, palette, positioning, or cross-location brand-consistency requirements.
The visual-reference change does not alter the booking platform, Coming Soon booking status, or future booking-activation behavior.
The source message concerns visual design references and does not change separate accounts, data, access, analytics, or operational tracking.
The master site's role, location routing, navigation behavior, and lack of centralized booking remain valid unchanged.
The referenced websites are design examples, not replacements for the specified SMASHROOMUSA.com master-site domain.
Changing visual design references does not change the requirement to reuse the location-site structure or its current customization and activation rules.
